name: BrightCap Ventures
decision_note: Southeastern-European VC backed by Bulgarian and Romanian public programmes (EIF/JEREMIE, Recovery plans) that invests in SEE founders and the diaspora; it is an investor in the Czech startup Kardi AI (round April 2025) but has no office in Czechia.

evidence.quote: We back exceptional technology founders from Southeastern Europe and its diaspora — builders with deep technical DNA, domain obsession, and the ambition to win global markets.
We look for people who have lived the problem to see what outsiders miss in Future of Work, Fintech, and Health.
Supported by the European Investment Fund and Ministry of Economy of Bulgaria with recycled capital from the Joint European Resources for Micro to Medium Enterprises (JEREMIE) initiative.
Od stávajících investorů BrightCap Ventures, Depo Ventures a Garage Angels a nově také od Lumus Investment Collective i nejmenovaného českého andělského investora získal celkem 28 milionů korun.

analyst_notes: Second-pass screen (co-investor in Depo Ventures' Kardi AI deal). hq_country BG is derived, not stated in fetched text: the site's funding notices name the Bulgarian Ministry of Economy/JEREMIE and the Bulgaria Recovery and Resilience Plan plus the Romania Recovery Equity Fund; no Czech office or team member found, so S2. Kardi AI's April 2025 round (CZK 28m total) was from existing investors including BrightCap; the date of BrightCap's own first entry was not established. The site's script data shows '€0.5-2M initial checks', but that text is not in the plain HTML, so ticket left not_disclosed; fund sizes were not checked (scope exclusion). Sector: Future of Work -> software_saas, Fintech, Health -> healthtech.
